analysis: The collision filter checks m.hit.Contains(u), but the accepted-collision branch clears m.hit and never adds the struck unit. This is a likely cause of repeated orb damage across overlapping ticks; it has not yet been reproduced. I need the damage rules to choose quantitative assertions with appropriate controls.
